'''Bollin''' is a horse handler in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==Appearance==
Bollin is a big man with squinty eyes.

==Activities==
Bollin is on guard at the entrance to the show when [[Murel]] and other [[Seanchan]] soldiers refuse to pay to enter.{{ref/book|11|7}}
